All 21 fixes are implemented, verified, and documented in `/root/agent-arena` (local commit `cbedac9`, nothing pushed, nothing submitted live).

**Shape of the solution**

- **The data layer is rebuilt, not patched.** `specs.ts` is gone. Each of the 10 Wave 1 markets is mined through a refresher that parses figures out of an HTTP-200 fetch made in the same run; mock mode replays recorded snapshots of real fetches and fails loudly rather than invent content. A mining failure skips the market — there is no frozen fallback, so the zero-hallucination invariant holds structurally, not by discipline.
- **The 5 dead URLs are replaced with verified live ones** and the recomputed data flips several run-1 stances (run-1's fabricated figures had them backwards): Destatis is actually 126.5 / 122.7 → DE CPI needs only a −0.29% MoM print for ≥2.8% YoY (YES, not NO); Wikipedia needs ~426/day against a live ~469/day observed (YES); Go's milestone is **457** found by title (14 open/18 closed, not 87); the FIDE match is actually 1–1 after game 2 with Sindarov rated 2782 vs 2712; Electografía tracks Vox at 19.1% / 64 seats.
- **The gate bites now**: the item-count rule (`1 + links.length + files.length ≤ 3`) actually rejected 2-link specs in the first re-run, so all drafts ship note + 1 link + CSV, with the second source fully cited inline and in the CSV's `source,url,fetchedAt` rows. Slots use `remainingOnMarket` directly; note-length/file-size/freshness/domain/phrase-linter rules are added and tested; `verifySources` covers api-json links and cross-checks every note figure against the fetched content.
- **Ledger is mode-tagged** (mock never blocks live, run-1 entries archived in `evidence-log-run1-archive.jsonl`), and the submitter never re-submits a draft, logs its idempotency key before any POST, waits 30 minutes, and writes the verdict back.

**Verification:** `npm test` 42/42 (15 original intents preserved + 27 new), `tsc --noEmit` clean, `npm run mock` re-mines 10/10 drafts with 0 gate rejects and 0 mining failures, and the immediate re-run writes 0 new drafts. Live values were checked against the public sources in-session and recorded in `FIX-REPORT.md`.

**Honest gaps** (also in FIX-REPORT): `npm run plan -- --mode=live` and the submit path itself can't be exercised without a Delphi key; Firecrawl's live search is unkeyed; the stated model assumptions (seasonal MoM lists, poll→final history, draw share) remain assumptions, clearly labeled in every note; and the freshness rule distinguishes past baselines (hard `fetchedAt > baseline`) from future window-start markets (same-run freshness), which is a documented interpretation QA may want to confirm.
